lines.text: CHART AXIS FLOOR: a value axis starts at zero unless the values have one sign and span at
most a sixth of the largest magnitude, when the axis starts half their span beyond the value
nearest zero and a twentieth of it beyond the farthest. A stacked chart is judged by its running
totals, and the step follows from the padded span and the length of the axis.
